8236586701.description: 6178. It's really fun and sometimes rewarding to browse through old photos in the image library in Adobe Lightroom. The next few days I will post some old findings. Here's a example of a motive from August 6, 2010. The square reflection on the wall was the main thing. One capture with people in the escalator and one without. Back then, in 2010, I choose the one without people, emphasizing the reflection (see below). Here's the one with people. Did I make the right decision?
